hlg.name: Enable Collaborative Sprint Goal Setting
hlg.description: Support the team in collectively defining sprint goals through an engaging, anonymous estimation process to foster shared ownership and alignment.

branches.hlg_prime: Implement an Anonymous Estimation Interface that renders a user-facing session token-based UI for team members to input estimates without revealing identities, while preserving session integrity and enabling anonymous aggregation of estimates.

hlg.name: Ensure Transparent and Consensus-Based Estimation
hlg.description: Allow all team members to contribute anonymously to task estimation, reducing bias and encouraging consensus-driven decision-making.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable team members to submit individual task estimates and aggregate them into a visual consensus view for transparency and decision-making.

hlg.name: Facilitate Productive Conversations for Shared Understanding
hlg.description: Enable real-time collaborative estimation with anonymized peer visibility, discussion threads, and immediate visual feedback via API-driven interactions to foster productive conversations that build shared knowledge and alignment around sprint goals and task complexity.

branches.hlg_prime: Enable real-time collaborative estimation with anonymized peer visibility, discussion threads, and immediate visual feedback via API-driven interactions.
